acceptance.given: The six materially distinct Matrix Cases and their immutable Stable and Candidate subject fixtures are defined by the Toolchain replay/evaluation implementation.

oracle.expected: Execution evidence records, for each of the six distinct Matrix Cases, one Stable-subject run and one Candidate-subject run, with fixture/state identities unchanged during each run and attributable case/subject identifiers.
forbidden: Any Matrix Case lacks either a Stable or Candidate execution record.
A Stable or Candidate fixture/state identity changes between execution start and completion.
Execution records cannot be attributed to a specific Matrix Case and subject.
oracle.observable: The matrix execution validator parses the evidence, verifies exactly six materially distinct case identifiers, and confirms each has immutable Stable and Candidate subject records with attributable evidence links.

acceptance.then: Run the Matrix Case execution validator against the replay/evaluation evidence after all six cases complete.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a Matrix Case fixture with its Stable or Candidate subject record omitted; validation must fail for incomplete subject coverage.
Select a case fixture whose Stable or Candidate subject identity hash differs between execution start and completion; validation must fail immutability enforcement.
Select execution evidence with missing or mismatched Matrix Case/subject attribution; validation must fail traceability checking.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure all six materially distinct Matrix Cases execute both immutable Stable and Candidate subjects, capture start/end fixture-state identity hashes, and emit attributable evidence consumed by validation.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay/evaluation evidence schema and case identifiers; rollback only Matrix Case subject-execution and identity-capture changes.

slice_hint.state_transition: No prior execution state to six completed Matrix Cases, each with immutable Stable and Candidate subject runs and attributable evidence.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation passes only when exactly six materially distinct Matrix Case IDs are present and every case has both Stable and Candidate records whose fixture/state identity remains unchanged from start through completion and whose evidence is attributable.

acceptance.given: An applicable Consumer has a bound rollback fixture with its Prior Route identity and Prior Behavior Baseline (verdict and diagnostic category) recorded before candidate-route exercise.

oracle.expected: The Consumer's rollback invokes the Prior Route through its real call surface and records the same Prior Route identity, verdict, and diagnostic category as the recorded baseline.
forbidden: Behavioral rollback is executed only through a simulated or non-real call surface.
A configuration-only change, candidate rejection, or error is accepted as rollback.
Rollback records a different Prior Route identity, verdict, or diagnostic category.
oracle.observable: The Consumer lifecycle receipt and its real-call result show a Prior Route invocation and baseline-equivalent route identity, verdict, and diagnostic category for the rollback fixture.

acceptance.then: Behavioral rollback has been executed by the applicable Consumer through its real call surface and restores the recorded Prior Behavior Baseline.
acceptance.when: Behavioral rollback is exercised after the Candidate Route is disabled or has failed and the bound rollback fixture is applicable.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the isolated rollback fixture through the Consumer lifecycle with rejection-only or configuration-only rollback substituted; the runtime observation must fail because no real Prior Route call restores the recorded identity, verdict, and diagnostic category.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add Consumer lifecycle rollback verification that exercises each applicable Consumer through its real call surface, invokes the Prior Route after disable or candidate failure, and compares the returned route identity, verdict, and diagnostic category with that Consumer fixture's recorded Prior Behavior Baseline.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay receipt compatibility while adding rollback call receipts and baseline-comparison fields; no persisted-state migration is permitted.

slice_hint.state_transition: Applicable Consumer with a bound rollback fixture and disabled or failed Candidate Route -> real Prior Route invocation -> recorded baseline-equivalent rollback result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: For every applicable Consumer exercised by the lifecycle selector, rollback has a real Prior Route call receipt whose route identity, verdict, and diagnostic category equal that Consumer fixture's recorded Prior Behavior Baseline; the rejection-only/configuration-only fixture fails.

acceptance.given: The RMAP-S2 evaluation-seed manifest is submitted for repository Toolchain validation.

oracle.expected: Validation confirms that each of the three named seed occurrences appears exactly once and records its approved non-baseline candidate classification.
forbidden: A named seed occurrence is absent.
A named seed occurrence has a baseline, unapproved, or mismatched classification.
Validation accepts duplicate occurrences as coverage for a missing named seed.
oracle.observable: The RMAP-S2 validator result reports the evaluated seed identities and classification comparison outcome.

acceptance.then: The classification coverage is accepted only when all three named occurrences match their approved non-baseline classes.
acceptance.when: The evaluation-seed manifest is classified during RMAP-S2 validation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the RMAP-S2 seed-validation selector with one named occurrence assigned an unapproved or baseline classification; validation must reject that manifest.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make RMAP-S2 validation compare every named evaluation-seed occurrence with the frozen approved non-baseline classification mapping and reject absent, duplicate, baseline, unapproved, or mismatched classifications.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the existing evaluation-seed manifest format and non-authorizing status; rollback only the approved-classification comparison without mutating historical seed evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: An evaluation seed occurrence with unspecified classification coverage transitions to a validator-confirmed approved non-baseline classification, while an unapproved classification transitions to rejection.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: RMAP-S2 succeeds only when all three named seed occurrences are unique and match the frozen approved non-baseline classifications; the isolated unapproved-or-baseline classification selector fails.

acceptance.given: A replay-matrix invocation evaluates a matrix case whose returned evidence label does not match that case's bound matrix identity and category.

oracle.expected: During aggregate evaluation, the replay receipt reports status "fail" with a nonzero exit code, identifies the mislabeled case evidence as invalid, and the aggregate cannot be accepted.
forbidden: The aggregate remains valid or is accepted despite mislabeled matrix evidence.
oracle.observable: The replay-matrix process result and its aggregate receipt for the isolated mislabeled-evidence fixture.

acceptance.then: The aggregate transitions to invalid and no successful aggregate receipt is produced.
acceptance.when: When aggregate evaluation validates case evidence against the case label bound by the matrix input before determining aggregate success.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Invoke replay-matrix with an isolated matrix fixture whose evidence label is deliberately mismatched from its bound case category; fail the guard if the aggregate does not reject that evidence.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Bind each matrix execution result to its input case identity and category during aggregate evaluation; a mismatched evidence label invalidates the aggregate instead of contributing a passing case result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the existing replay-matrix receipt schema and valid matrix behavior; rollback only the label-to-case aggregate validation and its focused test.

slice_hint.state_transition: Aggregate evaluated with mislabeled matrix evidence -> aggregate invalid and non-acceptable.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The focused mislabeled-evidence selector observes a nonzero replay-matrix result and an aggregate receipt with status "fail"; no accepted aggregate is emitted.
